Messages.Author: jeroen rombouts
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Is it possible to give vamp without AUS a permanent +2 bleed in one turn?

There are a couple of possibilities, but they have a LARGE number of moving
parts. Things like Heidelburg and moving a laptop and one of the bleed
retainers to the same minion.

For those who haven't already figured it out, I'm trying to get a Mind
Rape - Justicar retribution combo to work. Any ideas?

thanks,
Jeroen

You could also do it with Freak Drive, but that merely moves the AUS requirement
to fortitude.

You could also use Sabbat Inquisitor votes to boost the vampire's bleed
(i.e., steal the vampire, have him employ Tasha Morgan and then name him an Inquisitor).

That requires that the vamp be Sabbat to begin with, but being a vote is a
bonus, you should already have plenty of votes for the Retribution.
What about this: put Palla Grande in play, then steal the vamp and make him
Clan Impersonate a !Toreador. Then you can call Sabbat Inquisitor with one
of your minions and give him the extra bleed.
Palla Grande sticks around for a couple of turns, so you can reuse it on the
next turn. OTOH, you'll need a !Toreador to play the card, so you'll have to
put a few in your crypt, or take a Clan Impersonation action yourself at the
start of the game. Still lots of moving parts, but it beats spending two
MPAs to give your target AUS.

Flux
